\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 197-200 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R205-first-pass-words-from-chapters-197-200}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for qeymeh and an olive.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a condition, a law, nevertheless, although, or
  \item must, an idea, a difference, an example, success
  \item polluted, greasy, strong, comfortable, smart
  \item shy, bad-tempered, serious, alone, selfish
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A condition? (\textbf{\fa{شرط}}, \emph{shart}.) A law? (\textbf{\fa{قانون}}, \emph{qânun}.) Nevertheless? (\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{این} \fa{حال}}, \emph{bâ in hâl}.) Although? (\textbf{\fa{اگرچه}}, \emph{agarche}.) Or? (\textbf{\fa{یا}}, \emph{yâ}.) Must? (\textbf{\fa{باید}}, \emph{bâyad}.) An idea? (\textbf{\fa{ایده}}, \emph{ide}.) A difference? (\textbf{\fa{فرق}}, \emph{farq}.) An example? (\textbf{\fa{نمونه}}, \emph{nemune}.) Success? (\textbf{\fa{موفقیت}}, \emph{movaffaqiyat}.) Polluted? (\textbf{\fa{آلوده}}, \emph{âlude}.) Greasy? (\textbf{\fa{چرب}}, \emph{charb}.) Strong? (\textbf{\fa{قوی}}, \emph{qavi}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{\fa{راحت}}, \emph{râhat}.) Smart? (\textbf{\fa{شیک}}, \emph{shik}.) Shy? (\textbf{\fa{خجالتی}}, \emph{khejâlati}.) Bad-tempered? (\textbf{\fa{بداخلاق}}, \emph{badakhlâq}.) Serious? (\textbf{\fa{جدی}}, \emph{jeddi}.) Alone? (\textbf{\fa{تنها}}, \emph{tanhâ}.) Selfish? (\textbf{\fa{خودخواه}}, \emph{khodkhâh}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{\fa{بارانی}}, \emph{bârâni}.) Torn? (\textbf{\fa{پاره}}, \emph{pâre}.) Crooked? (\textbf{\fa{کج}}, \emph{kaj}.) Stylish? (\textbf{\fa{خوشتیپ}}, \emph{khoshtip}.) Pale? (\textbf{\fa{کمرنگ}}, \emph{kamrang}.) Bland? (\textbf{\fa{بیمزه}}, \emph{bimaze}.) A stair? (\textbf{\fa{پله}}, \emph{pelle}.) A ceiling? (\textbf{\fa{سقف}}, \emph{saqf}.) A floor? (\textbf{\fa{کف}}, \emph{kaf}.) A lift? (\textbf{\fa{آسانسور}}, \emph{âsânsor}.) A dish? (\textbf{\fa{ظرف}}, \emph{zarf}.) An overcoat? (\textbf{\fa{پالتو}}, \emph{pâlto}.) A manteau? (\textbf{\fa{مانتو}}, \emph{mânto}.) A headscarf? (\textbf{\fa{روسری}}, \emph{rusari}.) Jeans? (\textbf{\fa{جین}}, \emph{jin}.) A pullover? (\textbf{\fa{پلیور}}, \emph{poliver}.) A cutlet?
